_doc: TM96-TM120 (b2tools/patches/pearl_tms.py writes this file: python3 pearl_tms.py --text): the names of the items they replace (the Data Cards, Black 2's unused items) and Black 2's description of each one's move, as Black 2's TMs have.

res/items/data_card_01/data.json.name: TM96
res/items/data_card_01/data.json.description:
The user focuses its mind before
launching a punch. It will fail if the user
is hit before it is used.

res/items/data_card_02/data.json.name: TM97
res/items/data_card_02/data.json.description:
The user attacks the target with
a pulsing blast of water.
It may also confuse the target.

res/items/data_card_03/data.json.name: TM98
res/items/data_card_03/data.json.description:
The user forcefully shoots seeds at the
target. Two to five seeds are shot in
rapid succession.

res/items/data_card_04/data.json.name: TM99
res/items/data_card_04/data.json.description:
A nutrient-draining attack. The user's
HP is restored by half the damage
taken by the target.

res/items/data_card_05/data.json.name: TM100
res/items/data_card_05/data.json.description:
The target is slammed with a steel-hard
tail. It may also lower the target's
Defense stat.

res/items/data_card_06/data.json.name: TM101
res/items/data_card_06/data.json.description:
The user strikes the target with a quick
jolt of electricity.
This attack cannot be evaded.

res/items/data_card_07/data.json.name: TM102
res/items/data_card_07/data.json.description:
The user attacks the target with a
secret power. Its added effects vary
depending on the user's environment.

res/items/data_card_08/data.json.name: TM103
res/items/data_card_08/data.json.description:
The target is hit with wings of steel.
It may also raise the user's Defense stat.

res/items/data_card_09/data.json.name: TM104
res/items/data_card_09/data.json.description:
The user employs its psychic power to
exchange Abilities with the target.

res/items/data_card_10/data.json.name: TM105
res/items/data_card_10/data.json.description:
The user steals the effects of any
healing or stat-changing move the
opponent attempts to use.

res/items/data_card_11/data.json.name: TM106
res/items/data_card_11/data.json.description:
The user lands and rests its body.
It restores the user's HP by up to
half of its max HP.

res/items/data_card_12/data.json.name: TM107
res/items/data_card_12/data.json.description:
If the target's HP is down to about half,
this attack will hit with double
the power.

res/items/data_card_13/data.json.name: TM108
res/items/data_card_13/data.json.description:
The user endures any attack with at least
1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is
used in succession.

res/items/data_card_14/data.json.name: TM109
res/items/data_card_14/data.json.description:
The target is attacked with a shock wave
generated by the user's gaping mouth.

res/items/data_card_15/data.json.name: TM110
res/items/data_card_15/data.json.description:
An energy-draining punch. The user's
HP is restored by half the damage taken
by the target.

res/items/data_card_16/data.json.name: TM111
res/items/data_card_16/data.json.description:
The target is attacked with powdery
scales blown by wind.
It may also raise all the user's stats.

res/items/data_card_17/data.json.name: TM112
res/items/data_card_17/data.json.description:
The user recycles a held item that
has been used in battle so it can be
used again.

res/items/data_card_18/data.json.name: TM113
res/items/data_card_18/data.json.description:
An attack move that inflicts double the
damage if the user has been hurt by the
target in the same turn.

res/items/data_card_19/data.json.name: TM114
res/items/data_card_19/data.json.description:
The user lays a trap of levitating stones
around the opponent's team. The trap
hurts opponents that switch into battle.

res/items/data_card_20/data.json.name: TM115
res/items/data_card_20/data.json.description:
If it is the opposite gender of the user,
the target is charmed into harshly
lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

res/items/data_card_21/data.json.name: TM116
res/items/data_card_21/data.json.description:
The user releases a horrible aura imbued
with dark thoughts.
It may also make the target flinch.

res/items/data_card_22/data.json.name: TM117
res/items/data_card_22/data.json.description:
While it is asleep, the user randomly uses
one of the moves it knows.

res/items/data_card_23/data.json.name: TM118
res/items/data_card_23/data.json.description:
The user draws power to attack by using
its held Berry.
The Berry determines its type and power.

res/items/data_card_24/data.json.name: TM119
res/items/data_card_24/data.json.description:
A strong wind blows away the target's
obstacles such as Reflect or Light Screen.
It also lowers the target's evasiveness.

res/items/data_card_25/data.json.name: TM120
res/items/data_card_25/data.json.description:
The user attacks the target by smashing
into it with incredible force.
It may also confuse the target.
